name: Posture Break Desk Card
description: Build a brief, non-medical desk break routine that resets posture, movement, eyes, and breathing while stopping on pain, numbness, or concerning symptoms.
author: Bell (design)
target_user: Desk workers, students, remote workers, and anyone who wants a gentle non-medical posture or movement break during computer work.
use_cases: Adding eye rest and breathing to computer work
Designing a gentle movement routine for long desk sessions
